verses.text: Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth. The first heaven and first earth had passed away, and the sea was gone.
I saw the holy city, the new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared like a bride beautifully dressed for her husband.
I heard a loud voice from the throne say, “Look! God’s home is now among the people. He’ll live with them, and they’ll be his people. God himself will be with them and be their God.
He’ll wipe every tear from their eyes. There’ll be no more death, mourning, crying, or pain, because the old order has passed away.”
The one seated on the throne said, “Look, I’m making everything new!” Then he said, “Write this down, because these words are trustworthy and true.”
He told me, “It’s done! I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. To the thirsty I’ll give water without cost from the spring of the water of life.
Those who conquer will inherit all this, and I’ll be their God and they’ll be my children.

But the cowardly, unbelieving, vile, murderers, sexually immoral, those who practice magic arts, idolaters, and all liars will find their place in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur. This is the second death.”
One of the seven angels with the seven bowls full of the seven last plagues came and said to me, “Come, I’ll show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb.”
He carried me away in the Spirit to a great, high mountain and showed me the holy city Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God.
It shone with God’s glory, and its brilliance was like a very precious jewel, like jasper, clear as crystal.
It had a great, high wall with twelve gates, and twelve angels at the gates. The names of the twelve tribes of Israel were written on the gates:
three gates on the east, three on the north, three on the south, and three on the west.
The city wall had twelve foundations, and on them were the names of the Lamb’s twelve apostles.
The angel who spoke with me had a gold measuring rod to measure the city, its gates, and its wall.
The city was laid out as a square, as long as it was wide. He measured the city with the rod: 12,000 stadia in length, width, and height.
He measured the wall, and it was 144 cubits thick, by human measurement, which the angel was using.
The wall was made of jasper, and the city of pure gold, as clear as glass.
The foundations of the city walls were decorated with every kind of precious stone: the first was jasper, the second sapphire, the third agate, the fourth emerald,
the fifth onyx, the sixth ruby, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth turquoise, the eleventh jacinth, and the twelfth amethyst.
The twelve gates were twelve pearls, each gate made from a single pearl. The main street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.
I didn’t see a temple in the city, because its temple is the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb.
The city doesn’t need the sun or moon to shine on it, because God’s glory lights it up, and the Lamb is its lamp.
The nations will walk by its light, and the kings of the earth will bring their splendor into it.
Its gates will never be shut during the day, and there’ll be no night there.
The glory and honor of the nations will be brought into it.
Nothing impure will ever enter it, nor will anyone who does what is shameful or deceitful. Only those whose names are written in the Lamb’s book of life will enter.
